items.title: 19.4 Nomenclature of Aliphatic Organic Compounds (aliphatic organic compounds ke naam) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 19.4, PDF pages 41-44.

blocks.text: Qudrat mein karoron organic compounds milte hain aur har saal laakhon naye compounds banaye ja rahe hain. Is liye zaroorat mehsoos hui ke in compounds ke naam un ke structure ke mutabiq rakhe jayein. Is maqsad ke liye IUPAC (International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry) ne rules (usool) banaye. Kisi organic compound ka systematic ya IUPAC naam us ke parent hydrocarbon par based hota hai. Har naam ke yeh hisse hote hain:
